from: Crossmaze is an interactive education place where children learn to excel along with the choice of their preferences. Children under the age of 5 have a strong visual understanding, so a practical approach suits them best, and visual learning is everlasting. We understand that each kid is special, and with a wide range of activities and learning material we lay a strong foundation for each child.

Our learning and education program is designed to eliminate the achievement gap and encourage every student to become equally successful. Good pre-schooling is the first milestone in the development and growth of children, and a strong, positive self-image is the best possible preparation for success.

At Crossmaze, activities are designed to give children opportunities to develop confidence and a positive image of themselves. Continuous motivation from teachers helps our students build a positive self-image, which in turn makes them confident individuals.
to: Crossmaze is an interactive place of learning where children grow and excel while following their own interests. Children under five understand the world best through what they see and do, so we teach in a practical, hands-on way, and what they learn visually stays with them. Every child is special, and our wide range of activities and learning materials helps us lay a strong foundation for each one.

Good preschooling is the first milestone in a child’s growth. Our learning program is designed to close the achievement gap and help every child succeed, because a strong, positive self-image is the best preparation for success.

Every activity at Crossmaze gives children a chance to build confidence and feel good about themselves. With steady encouragement from their teachers, our children develop a positive self-image and grow into confident individuals.

from.q: What age can my child join?
from.a: Play Group is for 2 – 3 years, Nursery for 3 – 4 years, Junior KG for 4 – 5 years and Senior KG for 5 – 6 years. Day care welcomes children from 2 to 8 years.

A Montessori-based, thematic curriculum through our Foundational Development Program. By Senior KG it is aligned with the requirements of State, CBSE and ICSE boards, so children are ready for mainstream schools.
Preschool runs 9:00 am – 12:30 pm. Day care runs 9:00 am – 6:00 pm, so children can move from class straight into day care.

from.q: Can children from other schools join day care?
from.a: Yes. Day care is open to both Crossmaze students and children from other schools, and we offer pick-up from the nearby drop point of other schools.

from.q: Can I see my child during the day?
from.a: Yes. Parents get live CCTV access, and the Crossmaze Care parents app keeps you updated on daily activities.
Yes. In-house transport runs on pre-set routes within a 5 km radius of the centre. Seats are subject to availability, so please check with your nearest branch.

to.a: Yes. Parents get live CCTV access, and the Crossmaze Care parents’ app keeps you updated on your child’s day.
Yes. Our in-house transport runs on set routes within a 5 km radius of each centre. Seats depend on availability, so please check with your nearest centre.

to.q: How do I apply for admission?
to.a: Send us an enquiry, call us or message us on WhatsApp. Our admissions team will answer your questions and arrange a visit to your nearest centre, where you can meet the centre head and complete the admission.
